claim_definition: Verifies that the Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) audit export produced by the Only OS compliance exporter is mathematically valid: a third-party verifier can confirm the execution outcome and policy compliance without accessing the raw input data or internal state, and a tampered or fabricated ZKP is rejected by the verifier.
scope: Only OS ZKP compliance export path; Verifiable compliance pack generation; privacy-preserving audit for regulated industries
excluded_scope: Full SNARK circuit verification on-chain; ZKP proof generation latency certification — tracked for DGV v0.6.0

test_cases.description: Real commitment check: only-gate computes sha256(witness||nonce) and verifies it equals the provided commitment. The pre-computed commitment was derived from the same witness+nonce, so the proof verifies correctly.
Tampered commitment: the all-zeros commitment cannot equal sha256(witness||nonce). only-gate computes the mismatch and rejects the proof, confirming tamper-evidence.
